ID = document identifier REF = logical reference UQ = unique schema index 0..N = zero or many
Dashed boxes repeat an existing entity or identify a typed target; they are not extra collections. A resource selects one target type.
Mongoose references are not database foreign keys. Historical targets may no longer exist. Full field and index evidence accompanies this diagram.
